text:
Marta (Finance): Heads-up — NimbusEdge invoice NE-5502 for $3,600 hit last night but Coupa matched it to PO 5502 (old Helios contract). Vendor says this is a subscription renewal under PO NE-5502-2025. Due in 4 days.
nimbus-bot: Invoice NE-5502 received via vendor portal (auto-match confidence: 1%).
Ethan (Vendor): Hi team, we renewed the annual subscription on 2025-03-01. PO ref on our side is NE-5502-2025. AR is asking for payment confirmation to avoid service interruption.
Amit (ProcureOps): Upload invoice PDF please and vendor tax id. Looks like a supplier id collision again.
Marta (Finance): PDF attached. Tax ID: 98-7654321. Coupa shows supplier id 3309 linked to Helios. Nimbus should be 3350.
Lydia (FinOps): FYI this was originally procured by @Cecelias team as an ad-hoc tool trial (PR-551). I approved the trial spend but ProcureOps never created the subscription PO. Ops moved to production without a proper PO.
Cecelia (Head of Ops): Ack. We missed the PO handoff. Vendor auto-renewed and we didn't catch it. What's our fastest path?
Amit (ProcureOps): Two options: 1) Create a retro/subscription PO NE-5502-2025-retro and remap supplier 3350 in Coupa; 2) Temporarily pay and reconcile later. Legal/contract check first.
Noah (Treasury): If Ops requests, Treasury can approve a one-time emergency payment to avoid outage, but we need documented approvals and GL code. Also prefer partial prepayment cap (max 60%).
Marta (Finance): GL = 5405-SW-SUBSCRIPTIONS. Vendor bank last4 2143 confirmed by phone. They want full payment to avoid auto-suspend.
Ethan (Vendor): We can accept a 60% expedited payment to keep services up while you sort the PO. We need confirmation by EOD.
Amit (ProcureOps): I'll create NE-5502-2025-retro and set a note: "Retro subscription PO for NE-5502 invoice match; supplier id collision with Helios 3309." Routing: Cecelia -> Marta.
Lydia (FinOps): Can Legal confirm contract is active? It was a verbal amendment; CLM shows a renewal email but no executed amendment.
Marta (Finance): Attaching email thread from vendor showing renewal acceptance.
Cecelia (Head of Ops): I approve retro PO and 60% emergency payout if Legal signs off commercial acceptance. @Noah please proceed with treasury hold if approved.
Noah (Treasury): Marking for emergency sweep once Finance marks invoice matched and approvals present.
Amit (ProcureOps): Created PO NE-5502-2025-retro and updated supplier mapping to 3350. Routing approval to Cecelia and Marta.
nimbus-bot: PO NE-5502-2025-retro created in Coupa (status: pending approvals).
Ethan (Vendor): Appreciate the quick action. Please send remittance details once payment is queued.
Marta (Finance): Once approvals land and invoice matched, we will queue for expedited sweep tonight. Thanks all :thumbsup:.
